title: EvidenceRun
description: Unified schema for a real NASA microgravity combustion experimental run with full epistemic provenance.

run_uid.description: Unique identifier for this experimental run (e.g., PSI-25-RUN-001).

investigation_id.description: NASA PSI investigation identifier (e.g., PSI-25, PSI-98).

platform.description: Flight platform or apparatus (e.g., ISS (MSG), ISS (CIR), Cygnus OA-5).

material.description: Chemical composition or sample material specification.

gravity_regime.description: Verified gravitational acceleration regime of the run.

doi.description: Digital Object Identifier for the investigation dataset.

ntrs_ids.description: NASA Technical Reports Server document IDs associated with this investigation.

frames_shot.description: Total camera frames shot during the run without unit conversion.

outcome_class.description: Categorical combustion outcome derived strictly from explicit tabular columns.

outcome_source_column.description: Explicit raw column from which outcome_class was derived.

usable_for_matching.description: True only if run has an explicit outcome and at least two measured/converted environmental factors (O2, flow).

unusable_reasons.description: List of reasons disqualifying run from matching if usable_for_matching is false.

oxygen_pct.description: Chamber or oxidizer flow oxygen concentration in percentage by volume.

pressure_kpa.description: Chamber ambient absolute pressure in kilopascals (kPa).

flow_cm_s.description: Convective oxidizer flow velocity across or around fuel in cm/s.

extinguished.description: Whether flame extinction occurred before sample consumption or command stop.

spread_rate_mm_s.description: Linear flame spread rate in millimeters per second (mm/s).

burn_time_s.description: Total duration of sustained visible or measured combustion in seconds.

co_ppm.description: Chamber carbon monoxide concentration in parts per million (ppm).

co2_pct.description: Chamber carbon dioxide concentration in percentage by volume.

metadata.description: Optional investigation-specific raw fields, notes, or calibrations.

value.description: Numeric measurement, converted value, assumed constant, or null if missing.

unit.description: Physical unit of measurement (e.g., kPa, %, cm/s, mm/s, s, ppm).

source_file.description: Relative path to the source raw or calibration data file.

source_column.description: Exact column name in the source file, or specification description.

source_row.description: 1-indexed row number in the source file where this value originates.

value.description: Boolean outcome, or null if missing/indeterminate.

source_file.description: Relative path to the source raw or calibration data file.

source_column.description: Exact column name in the source file, or specification description.

source_row.description: 1-indexed row number in the source file where this value originates.
